name: Melt
description: Unpivot a DataFrame from wide to long (tidy) format, then join the melted result with a secondary metadata DataFrame.
usage: ``using`` names the primary DataFrame to melt; ``id`` lists the identifier columns kept fixed while the remaining columns become rows. Pass pandas ``melt`` options through ``args`` — typically ``var_name`` and ``value_name``. Note: Melt joins the melted frame against the secondary DataFrame on a ``column_name`` column, so set ``args.var_name`` to ``column_name`` for the join to line up. ``na_cols`` drops rows with nulls in the given column(s) after the join.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Identifier column(s) kept fixed during the melt (pandas ``id_vars``). A single column name or a list of names.

attributes.name: na_cols
attributes.description: Column name(s) from which to drop null rows after the join (pandas ``dropna(subset=...)``). A single column name or a list of names.

attributes.name: using
attributes.description: Name of the primary DataFrame (in the pipeline data dictionary) to melt.
